# s3orchestrator_bucket (Data Source)

An existing virtual bucket, declared by either the orchestrator's configuration file or its store.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A grant has to name a bucket that exists, and one the configuration file
# declares is not managed by this provider. The data source reads it from
# either source and fails the plan when it does not exist, rather than the
# apply. Its source attribute reports config or store.
data "s3orchestrator_bucket" "photos" {
  name = "photos"
}

resource "s3orchestrator_grant" "backup" {
  user_id     = s3orchestrator_user.backup.id
  name        = data.s3orchestrator_bucket.photos.name
  permissions = ["list", "read"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Bucket name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `max_multipart_uploads` (Number) Multipart uploads that may be in flight at once. Zero is unlimited.
- `source` (String) Which of the two places declared it, `config` or `store`. A `config` bucket cannot be managed as a resource.
